description: Strict re-audit of the full Hindi deck after calibration showed the lenient round missed 4.6× more issues. 12 parallel agents with stricter rubric (flag every textbook-formal sentence a friend would notice). Quality still uneven across chunks — some agents under-flagged their range despite the strict prompt. Use this alongside the original 225-card audit (docs/hindi-register-full-audit.json); together they form the candidate pool for rewrite.
method: Strict 12-agent re-audit. Calibration on cards 1500-1749 found 65/250 (26%); the agents on full deck found a total of ~360 cards new + overlap. Extrapolated true rate is ~25-30% of 3171 = 800+, but agent variance suggests real number is between 400-800.

quality_notes.agent_4_strong: chunk 793-1056 agent was thorough — found 64 issues including subtle ones like अहिंसा, सम्मान, कुम्हार, मधुमेह, संग्रहालय
quality_notes.agent_12_strong: chunk 2905-3170 agent was thorough — caught the entire academic/research-essay block (hi-2940 through hi-3014) plus discourse markers
quality_notes.agent_9_strong: chunk 2113-2376 agent caught 60 incl. passive Sanskrit constructions
quality_notes.agents_1_2_6_10_weak: These under-flagged their ranges. The same kinds of issues that other agents found elsewhere (Sanskrit vocab, passive constructions, encyclopedic phrasings) are present in those ranges but mostly waved past. A re-pass on those chunks specifically would likely add 50-100 more.
quality_notes.agent_1_data_quality: Agent 1 returned IDs from outside its assigned range (hi-1365, hi-1366, hi-1383, hi-1608, hi-1628, hi-1635). These overlap with other chunks and have been deduped.

recommendation: The strict audit + original audit together identify ~500 unique flagged cards. This is the action set. The weak chunks (0-264, 265-528, 1321-1584, 2377-2640) should get a focused re-pass before the full rewrite phase — those four ranges likely hide another 100-150 issues. After that, the realistic action set is ~600-700 cards.
